remarks: Extra large one bedroom unit on 4th floor with spectacular city views. Enjoy beautiful sunsets from west facing balcony. Wood floors in large living and dining area, with separate area for office space. Lovely foyer entrance with oversize closets, good size kitchen, full size washer and drier. Enjoy communal meet and greet area during spring, summer and fall, with picnic tables and comfortable sofas.  Complex has pool, gym, sauna, library/conference room, community room with full kitchen, 24 hour doorman. Closing end July
